# Pagan

> Pagan is a pioneering Turkish black metal band from Istanbul, exploring themes of paganism, shamanism, and mysticism since 1995.

## Site

- [Home](https://pagan.tr/): Band logo, hero, and latest updates
- Biography: band history and lineup
- Discography: releases with streaming links
- Shop: merchandise
- Media: videos and social links

## Releases

- Acolytes (EP, 2024)
- Heathen Upheaval — Remaster (2022)
- Rehearsal Tape '19 (Demo, 2019)
- Oz : In Transcendence (Studio album, 2007)
- Heathen Upheaval (Demo, 1998)
- In Hoc Signo Vinces (Demo, 1995)
